item.description: Seed Gap: Evolving Terminology in Fast-Moving Domains This note documents a gap in the Seed where existing rules don’t adequately address how to handle terminology evolution, deprecated concepts, and emerging language in rapidly-changing knowledge domains.

item.title: Seed Gap - Collaborative Knowledge Base Governance
item.description: Seed Gap: Collaborative Knowledge Base Governance The Gap The Seed provides extensive rules for individual/personal knowledge bases but lacks explicit guidance for collaborative or multi-author knowledge bases — vaults where multiple people contribute, review, or access different subsets of content.

item.description: Frontier Exploration - Knowledge Calibration by Use Intent The Gap The Seed provides robust rules for organizing knowledge (atomicity, linking, verification) but lacks explicit guidance for calibrating knowledge presentation to the user’s intent in accessing it.
